semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The association plays a supportive role in the semiconductor industry by fostering digital transformation and collaboration across the value chain.
summary: The Korea Industry Intelligentization Association focuses on promoting digital transformation within the semiconductor industry by building a digital-based industrial innovation ecosystem. It facilitates collaboration between demand and supply companies and supports initiatives like IDX in partnership with the government, focusing on industrial standards and authentication processes.
capabilities: Facilitating collaboration between demand and supply companies
Supporting industrial standards and authentication processes
Providing education and training programs, including certification
Organizing exhibitions, conferences, and networking opportunities

regional_presence.Korea: The association is based in Korea and collaborates with the government on initiatives like IDX to support the semiconductor industry.
